gem.incomingTip:
Incoming damage
x / y  —  the HP you'll lose if you play no more block (current block + end-of-turn relics)
over the minimum you can take by playing your hand's block optimally.
gem.offenseTip:
Your damage
x / y  —  the most HP you can deal this turn over that plus damage that lands before
your next play (poison, start-of-turn effects, …). Hover an enemy to scope both numbers to it.
